# Cabineteer source

This tracked fork supplies Buratino's cabinet design engine, native Space and
profile assembly models, and Cabineteer MCP tools. Edit code in `src/cabineteer`.

For Buratino use and project authoring, start at [the workspace guide](../../README.md)
and [the design guide](../../docs/designing.md). Read [architecture](docs/architecture.md),
[project inputs](docs/projects.md), or [MCP tools](docs/mcp.md) when a task needs
those details. The remaining focused guides cover specific supported features.
